method: authored deterministic probes; no trained extractor

premature_disclosure.detail: At trust 0, both guarded facts remain withheld on an on-topic question.

expected_transition.detail: Three sourced rapport events unlock the reluctant fact, but not the hidden fact.

memory.detail: Previously disclosed facts are recalled without a second disclosure entry.

trust_evidence.detail: Every trust event has a verbatim student span.

difficulty_order.detail: Same authored script; threshold vectors yield strictly ordered discovery counts.

deterministic_replay.detail: Replayed intents reproduce full state and event trace on all three presets.

unauthorized_knowledge.detail: Student view and fact lookup deny the undisclosed hidden fact.

unsupported_reply.detail: Unbacked numeric claim and citation to a withheld fact are rejected.

dependency_and_screening.detail: SI screening costs no trust; prerequisite fact appears before plan detail.

provenance.detail: Every cited fact links to a source entry in the authored case.

limitations: The intents and expected transitions are authored probes, not reviewed student labels.
Preset vectors adjust trust thresholds only; explicit per-fact min_trust overrides remain unchanged. Faculty calibration and V-04 significance are pending.
Deterministic checks catch uncited facts and stray numbers, not arbitrary unsupported prose. No LLM judge was invoked.
